adjudication.rationale: In `handleNewBooking.ts` the new `evt.destinationCalendar` assignment uses `: null` when neither `eventType.destinationCalendar` nor `organizerUser.destinationCalendar` exists (`destinationCalendar: ... : null` around the shown ~1060 lines), بينما most other event producers in this diff normalize “no destination calendar” to an empty array (`[]`) (e.g. bookingReminder/webhook/payments/confirm/editLocation/cancelBooking set `... ? [selected] : []`, and the Playwright webhook expectation was changed from `null` to `[]`). This creates inconsistent webhook payload shapes across event types. Additionally, the later team logic `evt.destinationCalendar?.push(...teamDestinationCalendars)` will no-op when `evt.destinationCalendar` is `null`, so collective team members’ destination calendars are dropped when the organizer has no destination calendar (or eventType has none), which is broken behavior introduced/exposed by this change.
